scope: Short constrained optimization workloads, not converged designs. Fresh process per job; timings include exports and reports.

memory.note: Sampled host RSS includes mesher children. CuPy pool figures exclude driver/context/library allocations and are not total VRAM. GPU cold start is included in seconds; host imports are excluded.
